title: Shipment discrepancy
passage: There should have been twelve chairs in this shipment. A. I will check whether the other two were sent separately. B. They are comfortable to sit on. C. The chairperson is away today.
passageZh:
這批貨應該有十二張椅子才對。
A. 我會確認另外兩張是否分開寄送。
B. 坐起來很舒服。
C. 主席今天不在。
audioScript: There should have been twelve chairs in this shipment. A. I will check whether the other two were sent separately. B. They are comfortable to sit on. C. The chairperson is away today.
